glossaryTerm.description: Reference to the glossary term being approved.

currentState.description: Current state of the term before changes.

proposedState.description: Proposed state of the term after changes.

proposal.description: Set on the request that decides a term an automation proposed; absent on every other review of the term.

proposedChanges.description: The term's changes awaiting review, by field name, each with the values it adds and removes. Set by the approval workflow.

proposedChangesBaseVersion.description: The entity version the approval cycle began from; proposedChanges lists the entity's changes since it. Set by the approval workflow.

proposedChangesIncomplete.description: True when part of the entity's history since proposedChangesBaseVersion could not be read, so proposedChanges lists only the changes after that part. Absent when proposedChanges covers the whole cycle. Set by the approval workflow.
